method: Derived actual .part URLs from gameconfig min/max and launcher padding logic. GET bytes=0-511 for first and last part of each non-template launcher, 12 workers, 12s timeout, retry once. Compared every listed part against current upstream GitHub tree snapshots where available. HTTP/part presence is not full gameplay verification.
